changes:
Aurora's shared first boot (root encryption and owner setup), power budget, GameMode defaults and secure-boot tooling, at alarm-aurora's pin, with the dracut initrd integration and Debian's kernel hooks.
Recognise Debian's initrd names when the console keymap changes (aurora-platform's Debian support, carried as a patch until the pin includes it).
aurora-harden-grub replaces GRUB's core image only when its bytes change, as aurora-boot now reapplies it after every update-grub (carried as a patch, as above).
